The '''Lithitanium rifle''' was a rifle variant appearing almost identical to the [[Cycler rifle/Legends|Tusken Cycler Rifle]]. However, this rifle was was built using an unknown metal component which created an improved, light weight and well balanced rifle.

==History==
This rifle was made available to spacers around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the Bestine Political Elections between [[Sean Trenwell]] and [[Victor Visalis]] for Mayor of Bestine. The position was decided by voting spacers, and during the occasions where Visalis was successful, his followers were able to assist him by killing a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Executioner]], hidden in the caves beneath [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]]. Upon returning the Tusken's head to Victor, spacers were rewarded with this rare rifle for their loyalty and assistance.

==Behind the scenes==
The Lithitanium rifle was featured in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayey online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It was received as past of the Bestine Political Election quest arc, when the player voted for [[Victor Visalis]] and he was elected. Upon winning the election, he gave the player a quest to kill a Tusken Executioner beneath [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]]. Returning the Tusken's head to Victor rewarded the player with the Lithitanium Rifle.
